question.prompt: The general term is \(a_n=4n−1\). What is the common difference?

solutions.explanation: The coefficient of the linear term, 4, is the common difference.
solutions.title: Read the coefficient

solutions.explanation:
The common difference is the change from any term to the next. For every positive integer \(n\),
\[
a_{n+1}-a_n=[4(n+1)-1]-(4n-1)=4.
\]
This difference is constant, so the common difference is \(4\).
solutions.title: Use the common-difference definition
